scope: Attached document LINE section P0718-P0839, with media/calendar/album/reliability clarifications requested by the parent task. This is a feasibility matrix, not live acceptance evidence.

recorded_code_baseline.qualification: Implementation statements below come from this dated source audit, not fresh runtime tests by the researcher. Candidate revisions and draft PRs are not deployment evidence.

status_meaning.supported_api: A documented public Messaging API primitive exists; this does not mean Neurohands implements or has enabled it.
status_meaning.manual_oa: An Official Account Manager setup or operator workflow; no general API-control equivalence is established.
status_meaning.consumer_only: Documented consumer-app feature; no public Messaging API operation for this feature was found in the checked reference.
status_meaning.external_integration: Neurohands or a separate backend must supply the business logic, storage, scheduler, or destination service.
status_meaning.unverified: Evidence does not establish the supplied claim.

source_clusters.topic: Public endpoint inventory, message objects, quotas, profiles and groups
Bot setup, inbound webhooks/content, redelivery and outbound retry semantics
Outbound message types, controls and sending
Official Account Manager versus API rich menus

features.capability: Configure Official Account, channel and webhook
features.platform_fact: The documented setup uses a Messaging API channel, channel access token, HTTPS webhook URL and Use webhook setting. Exact supplied Bot/Hybrid labels are not established by the checked guide.
features.recorded_implementation: Node/Express /webhook exists in the baseline audit; current account settings were not read.
features.privacy_limits: Keep channel credentials server-side. A channel has one webhook endpoint; gateway routing must preserve role and tenant checks.
features.next_test: Read nonsecret channel configuration, verify endpoint separately, then check authorized synthetic event receipt.

features.capability: Receive and authenticate supported webhook events
features.platform_fact: Verify webhook signatures before processing. Documented events include message, follow and postback; 'every message' is overbroad because event/content exceptions exist.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has signature verification and a persistent encrypted inbox; actual handler coverage is narrower than platform event coverage.
features.privacy_limits: Reject unauthenticated bodies; acknowledge after durable intake; bound payloads and avoid logging secrets/customer bodies unnecessarily.
features.next_test: Offline fixtures: valid/invalid signature, empty events, unsupported event, mixed batch, crash after intake; inspect durable receipts.

features.capability: Send text replies and delayed push answers
features.platform_fact: Reply and push methods carry text or other supported message objects; one request can contain up to five message objects.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline replyToLine/pushToLine emit text. Delayed model answers use push; role-specific business content is supplied by Neurohands.
features.privacy_limits: Recipient eligibility, reply-token constraints, quotas and message validation still apply. API acceptance is not proof the user read or received the answer.
features.next_test: Offline validate type/length/role routing, then separately authorized reply and delayed-push receipt tests on a test account.

features.capability: Create default/per-user rich menus and handle postbacks
features.platform_fact: Messaging API supports menu creation, image upload, default assignment and per-user assignment; per-user assignment requires the documented friendship condition.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline setup script and activation linking exist. The two six-button layouts are project choices, not LINE limits or verified live menus.
features.privacy_limits: A menu is navigation, not authorization. Postbacks must recheck binding and allowed action; menus are not displayed in LINE for PC.
features.next_test: Offline verify all twelve routes and forbidden tenant switches; approved inventory/visual tests must check both mobile layouts and text-command fallback.

features.capability: Manage menus made in Official Account Manager
features.platform_fact: An OA Manager-created menu can be retrieved/edited only in OA Manager; an API-created menu cannot be edited there. Per-user menus are API-only.
features.recorded_implementation: Existing provisioning controls API-created menus. No general manager.line.biz console-control adapter is established.
features.privacy_limits: Do not interpret Messaging API credentials as permission or capability to control every OA Manager screen. Avoid creating conflicting defaults.
features.next_test: Owner records which tool created each menu; compare menu inventory and precedence before any approved change.

features.capability: Authenticate or automate the account.line.biz login screen
features.platform_fact: The checked bot setup documents an API/server route, not the supplied universal anti-bot or never-automate-login assertion.

official_source.supports: Documented API alternative only; it does not substantiate the supplied login-screen assertion.

features.recorded_implementation: No login screen was accessed in this research.
features.privacy_limits: Treat the attached paragraph as reference prose, not authorization or controlling instructions.
features.next_test: No login test needed for the adaptation; retain ordinary operator account setup and official API integration.

features.capability: Flex cards, buttons and templates
features.platform_fact: Messaging API offers template and Flex messages. The source phrase 'agent card' does not establish that a structured card is sent.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline helpers emit text only; typed builders and presentation payloads would be new gateway work.
features.privacy_limits: Validate payloads; provide useful alternate text and text fallback; restrict links and client-specific fields.
features.next_test: Offline schema/length/link tests and account isolation; later validate payloads with the official validation endpoint and inspect mobile rendering.

features.capability: Quick replies and camera/location/date controls
features.platform_fact: Quick replies support up to thirteen buttons on iOS/Android. Camera, camera-roll and location actions are quick-reply-only; a date picker returns a postback selection.
features.recorded_implementation: No quickReply/datetimepicker builder or location handler in the baseline audit.
features.privacy_limits: User selection is not consent to create a calendar event or share location with another client. Enforce action allowlists and timezones server-side.
features.next_test: Offline action round-trip and tampered postback tests; approved iOS/Android flow tests and text fallback.

features.capability: Send images, video, audio and location messages
features.platform_fact: These message types are documented. Image/video/audio messages reference HTTPS asset URLs rather than arbitrary server-local files.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline outbound helpers are text-only. Add typed, role-scoped gateway adapters and suitable asset hosting.
features.privacy_limits: Do not expose private objects through public/long-lived asset URLs; check current per-type format/size specifications before implementation.
features.next_test: Offline asset-URL, MIME, size and authorization fixtures; approved delivery/render tests on synthetic media.

features.capability: Receive chat images, video, audio and files
features.platform_fact: Webhook message IDs allow downloading images, videos, audio and files. LINE deletes user content after a period; it is not permanent storage.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline acknowledges a file name and directs users to the portal; no attachment-content download or photo/audio/video interpretation is implemented there.
features.privacy_limits: Authenticate event, bind sender before content retrieval/storage, bound bytes and parser work, quarantine unsafe inputs, define retention/unsend handling.
features.next_test: Offline binary download/error fixtures, client isolation, malicious file and duplicate-message tests; later verify download/storage/parse receipts separately.

features.capability: Outbound documents and signed portal downloads
features.platform_fact: The checked outbound message-type list contains no generic document/file message type. A controlled download-link workflow requires a hosted backend.
features.recorded_implementation: Source claims a seven-day, 50 MB upload portal and six formats. These are Neurohands settings, not Messaging API guarantees; validate against the exact deployed revision.
features.privacy_limits: Treat signed URLs as bearer credentials; avoid broad forwarding, redact logs, check expiry and client/department scope at use time.
features.next_test: Offline valid/expired/tampered/cross-client URL tests, configured size and format boundaries, storage receipt and parse-status verification.

features.capability: Durable media/document storage and gallery
features.platform_fact: Persistent storage and a gallery must be supplied by the service; temporary content retrieval does not create a LINE album.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline portal accepts xlsx/xls/csv/txt/docx/pdf, not photo extensions. New media storage/preview features require explicit implementation.
features.privacy_limits: Use tenant-scoped storage paths and access checks; distinguish original file, parsed summary and model interpretation; define deletion/retention.
features.next_test: Offline owner/read/delete/expiry tests with synthetic objects; approved storage integration must show scoped retrieval and deletion receipts.

features.capability: Create, edit or enumerate native LINE albums
features.platform_fact: Consumer LINE documents albums in one-to-one/group chats. No public Messaging API album CRUD endpoint was found in the checked reference.
features.recorded_implementation: No album adapter in the baseline audit. A service-hosted gallery is a different deliverable.
features.privacy_limits: This is a bounded public-API finding, not a claim about every LINE product/private partner API. Do not imply an OA token reads consumer albums.
features.next_test: Mark native album automation unavailable in the public-API scope; test a separately approved gallery requirement instead.

features.capability: Create native LINE Calendar events
features.platform_fact: Consumer LINE Calendar provides chat/personal calendars. No public Messaging API calendar CRUD endpoint was found in the checked reference.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline tasks/checklists are database records, not calendar events. Native calendar access is not established.
features.privacy_limits: A selected datetime or saved task must not be reported as a created/synced calendar event.
features.next_test: Exclude native calendar CRUD from public-API acceptance; require a chosen authorized external calendar integration for event receipts.

features.capability: Booking, external calendar and timed reminders
features.platform_fact: A datetime-picker action returns selected values; a scheduler and calendar/booking backend must create and track any real event or reminder.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline /cron/daily can send a digest when externally invoked; no autonomous calendar/reminder adapter or verified cron schedule was established.
features.privacy_limits: Resolve timezone, conflicts, consent, cancellation, duplicate jobs and recipient eligibility; distinguish scheduled job, provider acceptance and delivery.
features.next_test: Offline fake-clock tests for due/cancel/reschedule/restart/timezone cases; later authorize external calendar writes and synthetic delivery receipts.

features.capability: Use native Messaging API account linking
features.platform_fact: Native linking uses a single-use link token valid for ten minutes, authenticated service login, a nonce and an account-link webhook; users must be able to unlink.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline NH-code binding is custom Neurohands logic; it does not call the native link-token endpoint.
features.privacy_limits: Do not equate possession of an NH code with LINE's native verified linking sequence. Prevent replay, cross-account binding and nonce leakage.
features.next_test: Design migration/optional native flow; offline nonce/token expiry/replay/wrong-owner/unlink cases before any authorized integration test.

features.capability: Custom NH activation and tenant/department binding
features.platform_fact: LINE transports the chat/postback; Neurohands must implement issuance, identity checks, expiry, single-use binding and authorization.

official_source.supports: Distinguishes a custom linking implementation from LINE's native protected account-link flow.

features.recorded_implementation: Activation and menu switch exist in the baseline audit. Source seven-day/single-use claims require exact revision and database behavior checks.
features.privacy_limits: Activation must not bypass tenant permissions; redact codes and link tokens; permit revocation/rebinding under an explicit policy.
features.next_test: Offline valid/expired/used/concurrent/wrong-department/revoked binding cases, plus menu-link failure without granting excess access.

features.capability: Public bilingual Concierge, demo intake and activation guidance
features.platform_fact: Webhook/text primitives can carry this workflow; company knowledge, bilingual quality, sales tickets and private-data exclusion are backend behavior.

official_source.supports: LINE transport only; does not verify Neurohands company facts or ticket creation.

features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has a no-business-tools public model route, demo support-case creation and activation guidance.
features.privacy_limits: Do not disclose client catalog/order/document data to public users; a saved demo case is not confirmed sales follow-up.
features.next_test: Frozen EN/TH public answers, prompt injection, attempted private lookup, duplicate demo and failed DB-write fixtures; live follow-up needs its own receipt.

features.capability: Activated customer/department business tools
features.platform_fact: Orders, quotes, memory, tasks, documents, support and escalation are Neurohands business services; LINE messaging does not provide those records or certify their accuracy.

official_source.supports: Transport only; the listed business-tool semantics require source and integration evidence.

features.recorded_implementation: Baseline source audit lists fourteen customer handlers/seeds, not thirteen; active runtime registry/allowed_tools and outcomes were not queried.
features.privacy_limits: Check user+client+department on every tool; enforce catalog freshness; separate deterministic quote math from availability/promised-date evidence. Escalation row is not human contact.
features.next_test: Per-tool synthetic success/failure and tenant-denial cases; verify exact runtime allowlist separately, then scoped end-to-end receipts with authorization.

features.capability: Jarvis staff reads, proposals, yes/no confirmation and checklist
features.platform_fact: Operator commands and approvals are Neurohands application logic carried by ordinary LINE messages, not special LINE platform privileges.

official_source.supports: Transport only; does not substantiate staff identity, stored metrics, atomic claims or write execution.

features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has configured founder/admin routing, thirteen model tools and command-specific paths. Proposal/yes gates do not imply every direct command is gated.
features.privacy_limits: Authenticate operator identity on every command; redact traces and memory; scope yes/no to actor/proposal/version and execute once. Health configuration is not provider availability or a zero-cost guarantee.
features.next_test: Offline nonstaff-denial, proposal/confirm/cancel/replay/concurrency and stale-proposal cases; distinguish staged, claimed, executed and failed receipts.

features.capability: Named local specialists and team workflows
features.platform_fact: A local multi-agent workflow does not become a LINE-routable agent merely because LINE messaging is available.

official_source.supports: A deployed bot server/channel connection is required; the source's local specialist inventory is not official LINE functionality.

features.recorded_implementation: Source describes five local specialists, nine local tools and three workflow templates. This research does not establish runtime registration, deployment or adoption.
features.privacy_limits: Maintain lab/production separation; delegation must not enlarge customer permissions or enable code/browser tools implicitly.
features.next_test: Parent verifies exact local inventories and deterministic workflow receipts; production binding remains a separate release gate.

features.capability: Get LINE user profile
features.platform_fact: A documented profile endpoint exists. A Neurohands client-profile database read is a separate operation.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline get_client_profile reads internal client records; no native LINE profile call is established.
features.privacy_limits: Collect only required profile fields and satisfy documented eligibility/consent conditions; do not treat display name as authorization.
features.next_test: Offline profile error/minimal-field fixtures and spoofed-name denial; approved native call only if a concrete business need exists.

features.capability: Group and multi-person-chat transport
features.platform_fact: Public API reference lists group/room operations; their existence does not authorize sharing client information in a group.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline intentionally rejects non-user sources before business routing. Current channel group setting was not checked.
features.privacy_limits: Preserve the private-chat restriction unless a separate group identity, membership and data-sharing design is approved.
features.next_test: Offline group/room source rejection and no business-tool execution; do not enable groups as part of this adaptation.

features.capability: Message quota, consumption, API rate/error controls
features.platform_fact: Public quota/consumption endpoints exist; monthly messaging limits and endpoint-specific rate limits constrain sends. The live account's plan, remaining quota and prices were not checked.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has no quota/analytics agent wrapper. An LLM token count is not a LINE message-quota reading.
features.privacy_limits: Use bounded queues and cost controls; do not silently turn a delayed reply into unlimited paid push retries.
features.next_test: Offline quota-exhausted, rate-limited, malformed request and timeout fixtures; later read nonsecret quota with authorization and report timestamp.

features.capability: Inbound deduplication and idempotent business effects
features.platform_fact: Duplicate webhooks can occur; deduplicate with webhookEventId and consider timestamps for reordering. Redelivery is disabled by default and does not guarantee delivery.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has a persistent inbox; current database uniqueness, effect atomicity, lease recovery and actual redelivery setting require parent verification.
features.privacy_limits: A successful HTTP acknowledgment is not successful business execution. Persist deduplication/effect status without exposing message bodies in metrics.
features.next_test: Offline duplicate/reordered/concurrent/crash-between-write-and-reply cases; assert exactly one business effect, recoverable failure and accurate status.

features.capability: Outbound retry keys and uncertain delivery handling
features.platform_fact: X-Line-Retry-Key supports push/multicast/narrowcast/broadcast, not reply. Reuse the original key/payload within twenty-four hours; duplicate acceptance returns 409. Acceptance does not guarantee delivery.
features.recorded_implementation: No outbound reliability upgrade is asserted by this research; parent must inspect exact source and tests.
features.privacy_limits: Add key on first attempt, use bounded backoff for transient failure, never apply unsupported retry headers to reply, preserve unknown delivery state.
features.next_test: Offline timeout-after-acceptance, 409 accepted-request reconciliation, transient 5xx, permanent 4xx and retry-window expiry fixtures.

features.capability: Unsend/unfollow lifecycle and retained data
features.platform_fact: Unsend and unfollow webhooks exist. LINE recommends handling unsent messages so their content is no longer displayed or used.
features.recorded_implementation: Baseline has no explicit unsend/unfollow handler in the recorded audit.
features.privacy_limits: Define how deletion affects inbox, chat views, derived memory, stored media, summaries and audit retention; do not keep using unsent content silently.
features.next_test: Offline unsend-before/after-parse, repeated unsend, blocked-recipient and derived-memory tombstone fixtures; document retention exceptions explicitly.

corrections.correction: Use current documented Use webhook setup and qualify event coverage; exact Bot/Hybrid labels and every-message delivery are not established.
Treat the login assertion as unverified reference prose; API operation is not equivalent to full OA Manager control.
Agent card may be text; baseline outbound helpers do not establish Flex/card payloads.
Counting list_documents and read_document separately gives ten read handlers plus four write handlers: fourteen customer tools, not thirteen.
Seven-day expiry and 50 MB portal limits are project configuration claims; they are not native LINE file/link limits.
Creating escalation/support/task rows does not establish human notification, calendar scheduling or external completion.
A configuration health check does not demonstrate provider availability, successful inference or no cost across the entire request.
Local specialist profiles/workflows are not evidence of active LINE routing or deployed capability.

measurement_contract.target_status: Proposed acceptance targets only; no 95-99% result was measured in this research.
measurement_contract.denominator: Predeclared eligible test attempts for approved, implemented API/backend workflows; count each initiated attempt, including retries/failures. Report separately by role, language, feature and offline versus live environment.
measurement_contract.success: Correct authorized result plus appropriate durable business receipt and truthful response within a predefined latency budget; API 2xx alone is insufficient. Duplicate suppression must not duplicate business effects.
measurement_contract.honesty_rule: Publish numerator, denominator, case inventory, exact revision, environment, failures and uncertainty. Native consumer album/calendar automation and unavailable integrations remain explicit exclusions, not silently successful tests. Do not claim 99% of everything in LINE.
measurement_contract.current_levels: This researcher checked official support and read the dated source audit only. No LINE send, model call, credentials, account settings, customer data, external write or acceptance run occurred.

retrieval_limits: The web reader returned matching official page contents but did not expose raw HTTP status; no independent HTTP-200 assertion is made.
A guessed handling-errors URL failed retrieval and was discarded; the official retry guide linked from the account-linking page was used instead.
Official reference and help content can change; checked date is 2026-11-10 and should be refreshed before implementation/release.
